methods.label: Substitute the known input
methods.explanation:
To use the known value \(f(0)=2\), set \(y=0\) in property (a). This is allowed because the identity holds for all real inputs. It gives
\[
f(x)=x+f(0)=x+2.
\]
Consequently, \(f(1998)=1998+2=\boxed{2000}\), choice E.
